instruction: Create a new slide in the presentation with the title 'Art Movements'

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a new slide with specific title. Evaluator checks total slide count is 2 and the second slide has the correct title.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: new slide creation (via slide count = 2) and correct title on the new slide (index 1)
Postconfig appropriately saves the file with Ctrl+S to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Partial credit scoring is logical: 0.5 for correct slide count, 0.5 for correct title, 0.0 if count is wrong
Metric correctly uses python-pptx to parse the PPTX file and extract slide count and title text from shapes
Title matching uses substring search which is reasonable for this task, though slightly more lenient than exact match
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider using exact title match instead of substring match to be more strict (e.g., shape.text.strip() == expected_title instead of expected_title in shape.text.strip())
